name: Assassin X!
desc:
fast paced, round based fighting. hunt your target.. but watch out for your assassin!

let us know if you encounter any bugs!
requires 2 players or more!

collect 400+ unique weapons.

[controls]
click - stab
hold and release click - throw
f - ability
q - ultimate
b - emote wheel
1,2,3,4,5,6 - emotes
